narr: As the remnants of Hurricane Ida moved northeast through the Lower Ohio Valley, its moisture interacted with a near stationary cold front over southern Indiana. This produced a favorable environment for heavy rainfall which resulted in isolated flash flooding across southern Indiana.
ev: Three water rescues were reported in Jeffersonville between 12:30 and 1:00 PM.
There was significant street flooding in the town of Dubois. The gymnasium was flooded at the intermediate school.
There were several reports of closed roads due to flooding across the county, including Orangeville Road near Prospect.
